summary: Earth System Trends is a student project by Team GUARDIANS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It helps users explore climate changes in Egypt, especially the Nile Delta, through temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind data. Using NASA POWER, interactive maps, and simple charts, our website makes climate information easier to understand and explore.
details:
Earth System Trends

Team name: GUARDIANS
Challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge

2. Project Idea

Earth System Trends is a website that helps people explore climate and environmental information in Egypt, especially in the Nile Delta.

It displays climate data using simple charts, indicators, and interactive maps.

3. The Problem

Climate change affects many parts of our environment. However, climate information can sometimes be difficult for ordinary people to understand.

People need an easier way to explore climate patterns in their cities and understand environmental changes.

4. Our Solution

We created a website that collects climate information and presents it in a simple and clear way.

Users can select a city, explore climate indicators, view charts, and find locations on an interactive map.

5. Main Features

  • City Search: Search for different cities in Egypt.
  • Temperature: Explore average, maximum, and minimum temperatures.
  • Rainfall: View precipitation information.
  • Humidity: Explore humidity levels.
  • Wind Speed: View wind speed data.
  • Interactive Map: Explore different locations.
  • Climate Charts: Understand climate data visually.

6. Data Sources

  • NASA POWER API: Provides climate and meteorological data.
  • OpenStreetMap: Provides map information.
  • Nominatim: Helps search for cities and locations.

8. Target Users

  • Students and researchers.
  • People interested in climate change.
  • Environmental organizations.
  • Anyone interested in exploring climate information in Egypt.

9. Project Goals

  • Make climate information easier to understand.
  • Increase environmental awareness.
  • Help users explore climate patterns in Egypt.
  • Highlight the importance of the Nile Delta.

10. Future Improvements

  • Add more Egyptian cities.
  • Include more historical climate data.
  • Improve data comparisons between different years.
  • Add more environmental datasets.
  • Support Arabic and English.

11. Important Limitation

Our website uses climate data from NASA POWER. This data helps explore climate patterns, but it does not directly measure water pollution, soil salinity, or coastal erosion.
